merge_method.tooltip: The method used to combine the audio waveforms.

pre_cfg.tooltip: If true, rescale the combined noise BEFORE the sampler's CFG combine, without clamping (can amplify). Matches the norm-scaled CFG used by models like Lens. Default false keeps the original post-CFG x0-space attenuate-only behavior.

clip.tooltip: The CLIP model used for encoding the text.

ckpt_name.tooltip: The name of the checkpoint (model) to load.

images.tooltip: The images to create a video from.

audio.tooltip: The audio to add to the video.

bit_depth.tooltip: Bit depth of the created video. 10-bit keeps smoother gradients with less banding, but some players and downstream nodes may not support it.

batch_size.tooltip: The number of latent images in the batch.

duration.tooltip: Duration of the empty audio clip in seconds

sample_rate.tooltip: Sample rate of the empty audio clip.

channels.tooltip: Number of audio channels (1 for mono, 2 for stereo).

batch_size.tooltip: The number of latent images in the batch.

fragment_shader.tooltip: GLSL fragment shader source code (GLSL ES 3.00 / WebGL 2.0 compatible)

size_mode.tooltip: Output size: 'from_input' uses first input image dimensions, 'custom' allows manual size

images.tooltip: Images are available as u_image0-4 (sampler2D) in the shader code

floats.tooltip: Floats are available as u_float0-19 in the shader code

ints.tooltip: Ints are available as u_int0-19 in the shader code

bools.tooltip: Booleans are available as u_bool0-9 (bool) in the shader code

curves.tooltip: Curves are available as u_curve0-3 (sampler2D, 1D LUT) in the shader code. Sample with texture(u_curve0, vec2(x, 0.5)).r

prompt.tooltip: Text inputs to the model, used to generate a response. You can include detailed instructions, questions, or context for the model.

model.tooltip: The Gemini model to use for generating responses.

seed.tooltip: When seed is fixed to a specific value, the model makes a best effort to provide the same response for repeated requests. Deterministic output isn't guaranteed. Also, changing the model or parameter settings, such as the temperature, can cause variations in the response even when you use the same seed value. By default, a random seed value is used.

images.tooltip: Optional image(s) to use as context for the model. To include multiple images, you can use the Batch Images node.

audio.tooltip: Optional audio to use as context for the model.

video.tooltip: Optional video to use as context for the model.

files.tooltip: Optional file(s) to use as context for the model. Accepts inputs from the Gemini Generate Content Input Files node.

system_prompt.tooltip: Foundational instructions that dictate an AI's behavior.

video.tooltip: The video to extract components from.

model.tooltip: The model used for denoising the input latent.

seed.tooltip: The random seed used for creating the noise.

steps.tooltip: The number of steps used in the denoising process.

cfg.tooltip: The Classifier-Free Guidance scale balances creativity and adherence to the prompt. Higher values result in images more closely matching the prompt however too high values will negatively impact quality.

sampler_name.tooltip: The algorithm used when sampling, this can affect the quality, speed, and style of the generated output.

scheduler.tooltip: The scheduler controls how noise is gradually removed to form the image.

positive.tooltip: The conditioning describing the attributes you want to include in the image.

negative.tooltip: The conditioning describing the attributes you want to exclude from the image.

denoise.tooltip: The amount of denoising applied, lower values will maintain the structure of the initial image allowing for image to image sampling.

image.tooltip: Image or video to condition the latent video on. Must be 8*n + 1 frames. If the video is not 8*n + 1 frames, it will be cropped to the nearest 8*n + 1 frames.

frame_idx.tooltip: Frame index to start the conditioning at. For single-frame images or videos with 1-8 frames, any frame_idx value is acceptable. For videos with 9+ frames, frame_idx must be divisible by 8, otherwise it will be rounded down to the nearest multiple of 8. Negative values are counted from the end of the video.

attention_mask.tooltip: Optional pixel-space spatial mask. Controls per-region conditioning influence via self-attention, multiplied by strength.

iclora_parameters.tooltip: Optional IC-LoRA parameters from a Get IC-LoRA Parameters node. Used for adjusting guide processing as required by certain IC-LoRAs (eg. those with a reference_downscale_factor > 1). When chained, each LTXVAddGuide uses only the parameters connected to it.

audio_vae.tooltip: The Audio VAE model used for decoding the latent.

batch_size.tooltip: The number of latent audio samples in the batch.

audio_vae.tooltip: The Audio VAE model to get configuration from.

img_compression.tooltip: Amount of compression to apply on image.

stretch.tooltip: Stretch the sigmas to be in the range [terminal, 1].

terminal.tooltip: The terminal value of the sigmas after stretching.

bg_removal_name.tooltip: The model used to remove backgrounds from images

bg_removal_model.tooltip: Background removal model used to generate the mask

image.tooltip: Input image to remove the background from

resize_type.tooltip: Select how to resize: by exact dimensions, scale factor, matching another image, etc.

width.tooltip: Target width in pixels. Set to 0 to auto-calculate from height while preserving aspect ratio.

height.tooltip: Target height in pixels. Set to 0 to auto-calculate from width while preserving aspect ratio.

crop.tooltip: How to handle aspect ratio mismatch: 'disabled' stretches to fit, 'center' crops to maintain aspect ratio.

multiplier.tooltip: Scale factor (e.g., 2.0 doubles size, 0.5 halves size).

longer_size.tooltip: The longer edge will be resized to this value. Aspect ratio is preserved.

shorter_size.tooltip: The shorter edge will be resized to this value. Aspect ratio is preserved.

width.tooltip: Target width in pixels. Height auto-adjusts to preserve aspect ratio.

height.tooltip: Target height in pixels. Width auto-adjusts to preserve aspect ratio.

megapixels.tooltip: Target total megapixels (e.g., 1.0 ≈ 1024×1024). Aspect ratio is preserved.

match.tooltip: Resize input to match the dimensions of this reference image or mask.

crop.tooltip: How to handle aspect ratio mismatch: 'disabled' stretches to fit, 'center' crops to maintain aspect ratio.

scale_method.tooltip: Interpolation algorithm. 'area' is best for downscaling, 'lanczos' for upscaling, 'nearest-exact' for pixel art.

longer_edge.tooltip: Target dimension for the longer edge.

refine_iterations.tooltip: SAM decoder refinement passes (0=use raw detector masks)

individual_masks.tooltip: Output per-object masks instead of union

positive_coords.tooltip: Positive point prompts as JSON [{"x": int, "y": int}, ...] (pixel coords)

negative_coords.tooltip: Negative point prompts as JSON [{"x": int, "y": int}, ...] (pixel coords)

max_objects.tooltip: Max tracked objects. Initial masks count toward this limit. 0 uses the internal cap of 64.

detect_interval.tooltip: Run detection every N frames (1=every frame). Higher values save compute.

initial_mask.tooltip: Mask(s) for the first frame to track (one per object)

conditioning.tooltip: Text conditioning for detecting new objects during tracking

driving_track_data.tooltip: SAM3 track of the driving pose video. Will be rendered into the pose_video_mask output.

object_indices.tooltip: Comma-separated list of person indices to include (e.g. '0,2,3'). Applied to both reference and pose video masks. Empty = all.

sort_by.tooltip: Order in which palette colors are assigned to the tracked objects (applied to both reference and pose video so each identity keeps the same color). Objects that appear in earlier frames always come first; within a frame, left_to_right = leftmost object (by centroid at first appearance) gets the first color, area = biggest object (by mask area at first appearance) gets the first color; none = keep SAM3's order.

replacement_mode.tooltip: False = Animation Mode (pose_video_mask has black background, reference_image_mask has white background). True = Replacement Mode (pose_video_mask has white background, reference_image_mask has black background).

ref_track_data.tooltip: SAM3 track of the reference image(s) (one identity per object, colored in batch order), or a plain MASK of the reference subject (rendered as a single identity).

filename_prefix.tooltip: The prefix for the file to save. This may include formatting information such as %date:yyyy-MM-dd% or %Empty Latent Image.width% to include values from nodes.
The prefix for the file to save. This may include formatting information such as %date:yyyy-MM-dd% or %Empty Latent Image.width% to include values from nodes.

format.tooltip: The format to save the video as.

codec.tooltip: The codec to use for the video.

encoding.tooltip: Automatic preserves compatible H.264 streams. Re-encode applies a custom CRF.

crf.tooltip: Lower values produce higher quality and larger files.

format.tooltip: ply: standard 3D Gaussian Splat with full spherical harmonics. ksplat: mkkellogg SplatBuffer (level 0, uncompressed), base color only spz: Niantic gzip-compressed (~10x smaller), base color only

generate_audio_codes.tooltip: Enable the LLM that generates audio codes. This can be slow but will increase the quality of the generated audio. Turn this off if you are giving the model an audio reference.

video.tooltip: Video frames as image batch. Assumed to be 24 FPS; subsampled to 1 FPS internally.

thinking.tooltip: Operate in thinking mode if the model supports it.

use_default_template.tooltip: Use the built in system prompt/template if the model has one.

erode_radius.tooltip: Erode the alpha matte by this pixel radius before cropping (avoids border bleed).

size.tooltip: Square image size. The model is trained at 1024; other sizes run but are off-distribution.

octree_level.tooltip: Octree depth for the preview decode (lower = cheaper/coarser).

num_gaussians.tooltip: Number of gaussians to produce for the preview (rounded to a multiple of 32).

point_size.tooltip: Maximum splat radius in pixels. Each gaussian is sized from its scale and capped here; lower = finer/pointier, higher = chunkier.

vae.tooltip: The VAE model used for decoding the latent.

temporal_size.tooltip: Only used for video VAEs: Amount of frames to decode at a time.

temporal_overlap.tooltip: Only used for video VAEs: Amount of frames to overlap.

num_gaussians.tooltip: Number of gaussians to produce (rounded to a multiple of 32). 262144 matches the octree's point density; higher oversamples the same points (denser, but no new detail) and costs proportionally more VRAM/time.

seed.tooltip: Seeds the octree point sampler (global RNG) for deterministic decodes.

pose_start.tooltip: Start step of the pose conditioning.

pose_end.tooltip: End step of the pose conditioning.

video_frame_offset.tooltip: Cumulative output frame this chunk begins at. Wire from the previous chunk's video_frame_offset output.

previous_frame_count.tooltip: Tail frames of previous_frames to anchor. SCAIL-2 trained at 5 (81-frame chunks, 76-frame step).

pose_video.tooltip: Video used for pose conditioning. Will be downscaled to half the resolution of the main video.

pose_video_mask.tooltip: SCAIL-2 only. Colored per-identity SAM3 mask video at the same resolution as pose_video.

replacement_mode.tooltip: SCAIL-2 only. False = Animation Mode (pose_video_mask should have black background). True = Replacement Mode (pose_video_mask should have white background).

reference_image.tooltip: Reference image. The first image is the primary reference (composite all identities onto it). SCAIL-2: extra batch images are used as additional views (back view, close-up, occluded background), each needing a matching reference_image_mask in that identity's color.

reference_image_mask.tooltip: SCAIL-2 only. Colored reference mask, batch matching reference_image (first = primary reference mask, rest = identity masks for the additional reference_image).

clip_vision_output.tooltip: CLIP vision features for conditioning. Model is trained with stretch resize to aspect ratio.

previous_frames.tooltip: SCAIL-2 only. Full decoded output of the previous chunk. Only the last previous_frame_count are used as the extension anchor.
